train_model: train a transformer sequential model on sequence data with hidden state caching and gradient accumulation
test_model: test a transformer sequential model on validation or test data with optional full dataset evaluation
compute_masked_loss: compute masked NLL loss that omits specified label tokens from the training objective
train_batch_step: run a single training batch step with forward pass, loss computation, and backward pass on a sequence chunk
compute_total_loss: compute total loss combining NLL loss and optional auxiliary loss with optional accuracy tracking
